error_message: 401 Client Error: Cannot access gated repo for url https://huggingface.co/nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1/resolve/main/voices.tgz. Access to model nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1 is restricted. You must have access to it and be authenticated to access it. Please log in.
root_causes: 1. HuggingFace repository 'nvidia/personaplex-7b-v1' is gated and requires HF_TOKEN with accepted access license.
2. Local GPU hardware has 4,096 MiB (4.0 GB) VRAM, whereas PersonaPlex 7B bfloat16 + Mimi requires ~18-20 GB VRAM. Real model execution requires either the 80GB A100 pod or remote GPU node.
